bindings.capability: source identity, declared architecture, licensing, and build-surface inventory
bindings.acceptance_criterion: The registry validates against its schema and every listed source path is present in the hashed attachment inventory.

bindings.capability: bounded thought, insight, goal, awareness, fatigue, and cycle metadata
bindings.acceptance_criterion: Native TypeScript contracts reject unknown schema versions and replay bounded consciousness metadata deterministically.
A failed write cannot replace the last verified local capsule or accepted ledger segment.
Self-assessment emits evidence-linked observations and cannot append accepted identity events.

bindings.capability: longitudinal identity and embodiment coherence tracking
bindings.acceptance_criterion: The tracker reports divergence without mutating canonical identity and its evidence can be replayed from recorded inputs.

bindings.capability: typed subjects, role-labelled relation endpoints, and deterministic traversal
bindings.acceptance_criterion: The native identity graph rejects missing endpoints and produces stable traversal and export hashes.

bindings.capability: wisdom, learning, reflection, and curiosity goal categories
bindings.acceptance_criterion: Generated goals remain proposals and require an applicable execution policy before external action.

bindings.capability: structured temporal rhythm for observation and reflection
bindings.acceptance_criterion: Scheduling changes preserve existing lifecycle invariants and cannot authorize identity mutation.
A future adapter demonstrates a real sensor or simulated-world source with schema validation and no canonical write authority.
A native implementation proves deterministic token-budget enforcement across configured providers.

bindings.capability: release provenance and independently verifiable artifact origin
bindings.acceptance_criterion: A release workflow emits verifiable provenance bound to the exact source commit and artifact digest.
A dedicated adapter proves nonce freshness, signature verification, replay denial, and capability scoping.

bindings.capability: embedded local model execution and conversion
bindings.acceptance_criterion: No archive inference or conversion code is imported, built, or executed by DeltEcho.

bindings.capability: standalone autonomous server and broad remote API surface
bindings.acceptance_criterion: DeltEcho does not expose the archive server surface or grant it IPC, filesystem, message, or identity authority.

bindings.capability: prebuilt executables of unknown build provenance
bindings.acceptance_criterion: No checked-in archive executable is copied, invoked, packaged, or referenced as a runtime dependency.

bindings.capability: model weights without attachment-level model provenance
bindings.acceptance_criterion: No attached GGUF is loaded, copied, uploaded, or executed by the DeltEcho build or runtime.
Credential and source scans confirm that no excluded generated artifact entered the repository.
